author: melolontus
body:
I found my Second BoG after 369 T9 dungeons Boss mode (I use bossmode with full bonus boosts of coins and rod to get more dungeon keys, so you can recover the key investment)

Remember that the bonus boosts doesn´t apply for the final reward, but for the mobs you kill in the dungeon, so you get a good amount of keys and orns.

I think getting a second BoG is a matter of luck.
